gen-comfortaa-gf-aref-ruqaa-ink: Aref Ruqaa Ink moves gently, its text serif strokes barely thinning anywhere. Comfortaa's cable-like lines and stretched spacing bring a friendly geometric front, while the lightly modulated body keeps the page feeling literary.
gen-comfortaa-gf-average: Comfortaa draws every stroke like neon tubing, with no thick-thin pulse, while Average adds a measured, reed-pen weight difference. Big, short headings are where Comfortaa earns its keep.
gen-comfortaa-gf-besley: Neon-tube roundness from Comfortaa, then Besley's dignified turn. Besley's text serif varies its line weight quietly inside each letter, so a full column of it reads smoothly and with editorial poise.
gen-comfortaa-gf-bona-nova: Neon-tube loops, friendly and geometric, in Comfortaa's drafting-pen line. Bona Nova's serif tempers its thick-thin swing without razor hairlines, so Comfortaa can keep the big, short headlines to itself.
gen-comfortaa-gf-bona-nova-sc: Wire-bright circles from Comfortaa meet the refined, gentle-stroked classic serif Bona Nova SC. But the pairing's best quality is how its small counters stay unclogged beside that drawn-wire weight.
gen-comfortaa-gf-brawler: Brawler is a serif with clear openings and a faint weight shift between up and down strokes, set against Comfortaa's contrast-free lines. The pairing's real draw is friendly geometry against literary restraint.
gen-comfortaa-gf-brygada-1918: Brygada 1918 is a traditional, dignified serif with the mild swelling of a worn felt marker. Comfortaa excels at smooth, swell-free geometry, while the body font's gentle pen-like weight shifts do the quieter work.
gen-comfortaa-gf-cactus-classical-serif: Authoritative but not stiff, Cactus Classical Serif opens its e wide and shifts its bowl weights like a half-turned flat brush. Comfortaa's uniform, friendly rounds give it a bright foil.
gen-comfortaa-gf-caudex: Caudex reads dignified, a text serif with a faint but real thick-thin shift. Comfortaa is best at big, ring-round friendliness with strokes that never swell, while Caudex handles the authoritative, gaping-mouthed text.
gen-comfortaa-gf-chiron-sung-hk: Chiron Sung HK is a text serif whose light modulation shows mainly on close inspection. But Comfortaa's never-swelling neon rings against that moderate contrast are what make this pairing worth a look.
